purpose: Functional deep-link manifest covering every indexed Zubaida session/content unit without duplicating mutable source labels.

derive.transmission_map: Decode source.t rows from ZUB-SESS-001 in row order; row position is source_order and first field is Gmail message ID.
derive.session_target: For each ZUB-SESS-001 s row [o,l,...], target_id = zs-<o>-<l>; hash = #session:<target_id>; parent = #transmission:<message_id at source_order o>.
derive.unit_target: For each ZUB-SESS-001 u row [o,l,...], target_id = zu-<o>-<l>; hash = #unit:<target_id>; parent = #transmission:<message_id at source_order o>.
derive.label: Resolve verbatim from parent preserved source line l. Never build identity from mutable titles/metadata.
derive.session_alias: Candidate alias = session-<source ordinal/range>. Emit only when unique within the same parent transmission; otherwise omit and use canonical target_id.
derive.group_rule: A grouped source boundary stays one canonical target. Do not mint synthetic child routes for unbounded sessions.

proof.validation: All 567 derived target IDs are unique; every row source_order resolves to one of 118 canonical source-bearing parent transmissions; source heading locators were validated by ZUB-SESS-001.
